Bash(powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command @'
$BASE_URL = ""http://localhost:3001/api/v1""
$body = @{ email = ""ketoan@nhaphangchinhngach.vn""; password = ""Admin@123"" } | ConvertTo-Json
$r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ""$BASE_URL/auth/login"" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType ""application/json""
$token = $r.data.tokens.accessToken

# Find order with decent totalAmount
$orders = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ""$BASE_URL/orders?limit=50"" -Headers @{""Authorization""=""Bearer $token""} -ContentType ""application/json""
$best = $null; $bestTotal = 0
foreach \($o in $orders.data\) {
    $t = [double]$o.totalAmount
    if \($o.status -ne ""COMPLETED"" -and $o.status -ne ""CANCELLED"" -and $t -gt $bestTotal\) {
        $best = $o; $bestTotal = $t
    }
}
Write-Host ""Best order: $\($best.code\) status=$\($best.status\) total=$bestTotal""
Write-Host ""ID: $\($best.id\)""

# Try creating a voucher with small amount
$vBody = @{
    type = ""RECEIPT""
    orderId = $best.id
    amount = 1000
    currency = ""VND""
    paymentMethod = ""BANK_TRANSFER""
    costType = ""Thu tien coc don hang""
    beneficiary = ""Test Customer""
    reason = ""Thu tien coc don hang theo yeu cau khach hang, chuyen khoan ngan hang""
    attachments = @\(""https://storage.example.com/receipt.pdf""\)
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
try {
    $vr = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ""$BASE_URL/cash/vouchers"" -Method POST -Headers @{""Authorization""=""Bearer $token""; ""Content-Type""=""application/json""} -Body $vBody -UseBasicParsing
    Write-Host ""Status: $\($vr.StatusCode\)""
    Write-Host ""Response: $\($vr.Content\)""
} catch {
    $resp = $_.Exception.Response
    $code = [int]$resp.StatusCode
    $stream = $resp.GetResponseStream\(\); $stream.Position = 0
    $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\($stream\)
    $err = $reader.ReadToEnd\(\); $reader.Close\(\)
    Write-Host ""Error $code : $err""
}
'@)
